Name: AT - SH's Little Duckies - Duck Replacers
Author: plurffle
Description:
Just wanted the coop duck sprites to match the ducks from my other mods ⋋(•⌔•)⋌ ♡
This mod replaces the sprites of the adult ducks with three color options (the vanilla green, brown, and white).


[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]How to install this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]Unzip the zip file and place the "[AT] SH's Little Duckies - Duck Replacers" folder in your Mods folder.

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is this mod compatible with mobile/multiplayer?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]I do not have the mobile version of the game, but I assume it should be work just fine in there since this is a Content Patcher mod. This should definitely work in multiplayer!

[b][size=3]Q: [/size]Is there going to be a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] version of this mod?[/b]
[size=3][b]A: [/b][/size]You can get that here! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44251]CP - SH's Little Duckies - Duck Replacers[/url]



I have a Ko-fi btw! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
